After reading the original thread, I had a related question.

The AC is able to employ the special text from the card before being
subject to contesting.

Thus all vampires have the opportunity to employ/use any special text
once they are played and prior to being contested.

Correct?

Raille

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Raille wrote:
> The [Anarch Convert] is able to employ the special text from the card before being

> subject to contesting.
>
> Thus all vampires have the opportunity to employ/use any special text
> once they are played and prior to being contested.
>
> Correct?

Abilities from being played are available when played.

Effects from being in play are not available if the card is contested as it is
played.
